annotations.text:
Pick a direction from the top row — same screen, three aesthetics.

The bottom row builds out the leading candidate (A — Ledger): the table spec, the design language, and the landing page.

If you pick B or C instead, the bottom row gets rebuilt in it.

The axis these vary on is DENSITY OF VOICE, not shade of teal.

A is an editorial ruled sheet. B is an instrument panel. C is the current app with the glass taken off.

All three drop backdrop-filter, the 28px radii and three of the five colour ramps.

The table carries every list in the product — jobs, audit log, users, sessions, ingredients, measurements.

So loading and empty are designed here, not defaulted per page. Both themes ship from one token swap; use the Theme chip above the artboard.

Copy is grounded in what the product actually does — consent axes, timezone-correct streaks, the three logging doors, self-hosting.

[YOUR PRICE] in the Pro column is the one number I do not have. Everything else is real.
